known_defect: v1 assigns an initial م as pattern_augment from SHAPE alone (>=3 residual letters); the adversarial fixture own-adv-01 exposes this overgeneralization; v2 repairs it. Kept for the recorded flywheel loop.

rules.text: peel leading ال then single-letter proclitics from clitic_inventory; a peel that leaves <2 letters is invalid (abstain false_stem_risk)
if the first residual letter is م and >=3 letters remain after it, assign م=pattern_augment and the next 3 letters as root (SHAPE-ONLY — the v1 defect)
an inflection prefix from inflection_prefixes may be assigned only when token_kind=verb_imperfect is declared
any letter left unowned, or owned twice, forces abstain pending_letter_ownership for the WHOLE token
